bench-cross/ — the crossing-tax benchmark's host pkg (the
crossing-fastpath plan, phase 0): `pub host fn` decls only — the
bodies live in rut-std's `bench_cross::pkg()` (the
mounting shape). Deliberately EMPTY bodies: whatever a call costs
beyond the callee's own work IS the crossing, so the bench row that
mounts this pkg (benches/workloads/crossing-nop) measures exactly
that. Mounted via `[deps]` like any tree pkg.
